def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Objects are the four same-shaped colored motifs; pack their bounding boxes
    # side-by-side at a common bottom-aligned row, preserving each motif exactly.
    colors=sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    boxes=[]
    for color in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
        boxes.append((color,cells,min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)))
    # Keep original horizontal positions; align the bottom edges of each shape.
    bottom=max(b[3] for b in boxes)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,cells,r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        dr=bottom-r1
        for r,c in cells:
            rr=r+dr
            if 0<=rr<h: out[rr][c]=color
    return out
